---
name: Bug report
about: Something in Arcanum CE went wrong
title: ""
labels: bug
---

**Your build**
The first line of `arcanum-ce.log` in your game folder (for example
`Arcanum CE 861447f`), and whether you play on Windows or Linux.

**What happened**
What you saw, and what you expected instead.

**What you did just before**
The steps, as far as you remember them. Which optional mods are on
(`mod ... =1` lines in `arcanum-ce.cfg`)?

**The log**
Attach `arcanum-ce.log` from the game folder. A new one is written each time
the game starts, so copy it right after the problem, before starting the game
again.

**The save** (if the problem is in a game)
Attach the four files of its slot from `modules/Arcanum/SaveCE`, for example
every `Slot0003...` file. You may need to put them in a .zip first.
